dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle area.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity consistent with a non-white individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker-grey clusters distributed across the mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light-grey baseline and darker mottled areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple small, discrete high-contrast white spots distributed across the dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several faint, low-contrast longitudinal linear markings visible on the lower dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-contrast dark circular feature located on the anterior dorsal midline.
